title: Principal Social Media Manager
description:

Join Amazon as a Associate Social Media Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Associate Social Media Manager with strong expertise in marketing. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute marketing projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 1 years of experience as a Associate Social Media Manager or similar
- In-depth knowledge of HubSpot, CRM, Leadership, Microsoft Office
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: R$80,000 – R$140,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

title: Senior IT Support Specialist
description:

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work

- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

We are looking for a talented Associate Compliance Officer to join our dynamic team at TTEC. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining general solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 8 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Analytical Thinking, Microsoft Office, Team Management, Stakeholder Management
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of R$220,000 – R$340,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

description:

Join Squarespace as a Senior Project Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Senior Project Manager with strong expertise in marketing. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: R$340,000 – R$560,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

description:

- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

We are looking for a talented Junior Civil Engineer to join our dynamic team at Veeva Systems. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 3 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, Agile, Python
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of R$40,000 – R$80,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Staff Accountant
description:

- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities

**Compensation & Benefits:**

- Flexible working hours
